coverage.note: 2026 (saved full list), 2024 (March release, June primary guide, October general guide) and 2022 general guide plus 2022 governor primary checked. Missing: a 2022 legislative primary list (none found), special elections other than via other groups, and WFP local chapter pages. The WFP search API was not usable and web search hit a rate limit before a 2022 primary guide could be searched for.

The NY category and a WordPress search list only 2026 legislative posts. Search results also name an Evan Menist SD-39 post and a standalone Adam Bojak AD-149 post, but neither URL could be fetched, so Menist is not listed. No 2022 or 2024 NY legislative or governor post found; Our Revolution chapters not checked.

NYC-DSA 2024 and 2026 slates complete from press releases. 2022: only six of the 13-candidate NYC-DSA slate are sourced (four via Common Dreams, two via the saved national table); the other chapters (Mid-Hudson Valley, Lower Hudson Valley, Buffalo, Capital District, Ithaca, Long Island, Rochester, Syracuse, Troy, others) have saved site reviews but their endorsement pages were not re-read. NYC-DSA press archive has no 2022 endorsement releases.

Saved directory cards for NY, 2022 to 2026, state legislative offices only (RFS does not endorse governors). Directory year used as election year; 2021, 2023, 2025 cards are local offices. 2020 cards are out of scope.

No explicit endorsement of a NY governor or legislative candidate found. The 2022 champions list includes NY-AD-130 Scott Comegys, a champions list only, so not an entry. The 2026 endorsements page has only NY U.S. House races. A 2024 endorsement page was not found (candidates/2024/ returns 404), so 2024 is unchecked.

2026 only: Sunrise NYC endorsements page and Sunrise Ithaca. No 2022 or 2024 pages found. Other NY hubs (Rochester, Westchester, Cornell, others) not checked. NYC "Our Climate Champions" list is not treated as endorsement.

gaps: Official results blocked: NY State Board of Elections (https://www.elections.ny.gov/2022ElectionResults.html and 2024 equivalents) returns a Cloudflare 403 to automated fetches and its certified results are PDF/XLSX. Results cite Ballotpedia district pages and Wikipedia for governor.

nysenate.gov returns 403 to scripted fetches (curl, and likely the verifier); Senate term-rule citations (Public Officers Law sec. 4, Const. art. III sec. 2, art. IV sec. 1) were read in a browser and may show as unreachable in verification.

Open States file has no member for: Assembly 1 (Thomas Schiavoni), Assembly 74 (Harvey Epstein), Senate 12 (Michael Gianaris), Senate 47 (Brad Hoylman-Sigal), Senate 61 (Sean Ryan). These 2024 winners are status unknown; the reason each left was not sourced. Only Zohran Mamdani (mayor) is not_serving with a source.

NYC-DSA "Socialists in Office" names incumbents (Brisport, Salazar, Gonzalez, Gallagher, Mitaynes, Souffrant Forrest, Shrestha) as endorsed by the chapter without naming an election for 2026, so no 2026 entries were made for them.

NYC-DSA 2022 slate: 13 candidates endorsed, only six sourced; nine are unnamed in fetched text (candidates such as Gallagher, Mamdani, Mitaynes, Souffrant Forrest, Brisport, Salazar likely, not sourced). Airtable embeds (DSA national table) render client-side, so those rows have no excerpt.
Evan Menist (SD-39) Our Revolution endorsement for 2026 is reported by search results but the page could not be fetched; not listed.

Governor: WFP 2022 (Williams, Hochul) and 2026 (Hochul) only. Our Revolution endorsed Jumaane Williams for 2022 governor per Wikipedia (citing the NYT), but no Our Revolution page was found; not listed. 2022 and 2026 gubernatorial endorsements by other groups not found.

WFP lists say some endorsed candidates are not on the WFP ballot line; all listed entries are kept. WFP 2022 and 2026 lists are undated or dated after the primary, so stage is general, though some endorsements may predate the primary.

RFS 2026 cards for Zahava Durchin (AD41), Josh Arnon (AD74), Mahtab Khan (AD24) and Ryder Kessler (AD66), and the RFS 2022 Michelle Hinchey card (listed as Senate 48; Ballotpedia SD48 2022 does not show her), have no matching result sentence on Ballotpedia, so outcome is unknown.

Ballotpedia general-election results dated 2026-11-03 are unofficial and uncalled races are pending (15 entries). Special-election winners: term_start left null because Public Officers Law sec. 4 does not set a start for vacancy terms.
The 2025-12-23 NYC-DSA release says Aber Kawas runs in Assembly District 34, conflicting with Senate District 12 on later NYC-DSA pages; SD-12 used.
Sunrise NYC Comptroller candidate and all congressional, municipal, and local endorsements are out of scope and skipped.
